description: Sushi Knowledge progression, daily passive grants and rollover ETA from SushiStuff 1.22 game helpers and the current save
target: Sushi Knowledge bonus and daily progression

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_levels
extractions.description: Current Knowledge level per catalog Sushi (Sushi save row 7, consumed by KnowledgeBonusSpecific)

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_experience
extractions.description: Within-level Knowledge experience per Sushi (Sushi save row 6; daily event adds XP and level-up subtracts the requirement)

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_bonus_specific
extractions.description: Game-computed current per-Sushi Knowledge bonus, including mapped static coefficient, current level, unlock state and tier scaling

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_experience_required
extractions.description: XP needed for each Sushi's current Knowledge level; direct KnowledgeXP_req(level) game helper value

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_bonus_next_specific
extractions.expression: (() => { const sushi = idleon.getAttr("Sushi"); const research = idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h.Research; return Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, tier) => Math.max(0, Number(research[35][Number(research[33][tier])]) * (Number(sushi[7][tier]) + 1) * Math.min(2, 1 + Number(sushi[5][tier])) * (1 + tier / 30))); })()
extractions.description: Pure source-derived next-level KnowledgeBonusSpecific preview using the exact captured formula and current game coefficient/unlock data, substituting current saved level + 1 without mutating game state

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_passive_daily_by_tier
extractions.expression: (() => { const sushi = idleon.getAttr("Sushi"); const gridEnabled = idleon.callFunction("ResearchStuff", "Grid_Bonus", 189, 1) >= 1; return Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, targetTier) => { let cold = 0; let milktoast = 0; if (gridEnabled) for (let slot = 0; slot < 120; slot++) { const placedTier = Number(sushi[0][slot]); const plate = Number(sushi[1][slot]); if (placedTier < 0) continue; const gain = idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "SlotEffect", plate, 0) * idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "KnowledgeXP_multi", slot, 0); if (plate === 2 && targetTier < placedTier) cold += gain; if (plate === 3 && targetTier === placedTier) milktoast += gain; } return { tier: targetTier, cold, milktoast, total: cold + milktoast }; }); })()
extractions.description: Game-side sum of the actual daily 'l' event contribution for every Sushi tier: only when Research Grid 189 is enabled, Cold plate type 2 contributes to all lower tiers, Milktoast type 3 contributes to its placed tier, using SlotEffect(plate) * KnowledgeXP_multi(source slot). This does not replay missed offline days.

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_passive_slot_inputs
extractions.expression: (() => { const sushi = idleon.getAttr("Sushi"); return Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, slot) => { const tier = Number(sushi[0][slot]); const plate = Number(sushi[1][slot]); return { slot, tier, plate, effect: (plate === 2 || plate === 3) && tier >= 0 ? idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "SlotEffect", plate, 0) : 0, multiplier: (plate === 2 || plate === 3) && tier >= 0 ? idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "KnowledgeXP_multi", slot, 0) : 0 }; }).filter(input => input.tier >= 0 && (input.plate === 2 || input.plate === 3)); })()
extractions.description: Actual occupied Cold/Milktoast source slots plus game helper outputs used as direct parameters of the daily grant; slot index is retained because fireplace modifier is source-slot based

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_bonus_total_1
extractions.description: Aggregate Knowledge bonus category 1, a direct input to KnowledgeXP_multi

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_upgrade_qty_38
extractions.description: Knowledge XP upgrade quantity 38, a direct input to KnowledgeXP_multi

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_research_grid_189
extractions.description: Research Grid 189 level gate for the daily Sushi Knowledge event; no passive grant is applied when below 1

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_shop_restock_seconds
extractions.description: Requested extraction to confirm the current game's exposed TimeAway.ShopRestock attribute and daily-reset timer units/semantics. Supporting state only; intentionally not a standalone copy assertion.

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_eta_by_tier
extractions.expression: (() => { const sushi = idleon.getAttr("Sushi"); const gridEnabled = idleon.callFunction("ResearchStuff", "Grid_Bonus", 189, 1) >= 1; return Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, tier) => { const level = Number(sushi[7][tier]); const xp = Number(sushi[6][tier]); const required = idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "KnowledgeXP_req", level, 0); let daily = 0; if (gridEnabled) for (let slot = 0; slot < 120; slot++) { const placedTier = Number(sushi[0][slot]); const plate = Number(sushi[1][slot]); if (placedTier < 0) continue; const gain = idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "SlotEffect", plate, 0) * idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "KnowledgeXP_multi", slot, 0); if ((plate === 2 && tier < placedTier) || (plate === 3 && tier === placedTier)) daily += gain; } const days = daily > 0 ? Math.ceil(Math.max(0, required - xp) / daily) : 0; return { tier, secondsAfterNextRollover: daily > 0 ? Math.max(0, days - 1) * 86400 : null }; }); })()
extractions.description: Game-derived subsequent full-day wait after the next scheduled rollover. The ETA core test subtracts station.nextDailyResetSeconds parsed from this same save's TimeAway.ShopRestock, then compares the remainder to secondsAfterNextRollover. The 86400-second conversion follows the daily rollover cadence; this normalization avoids false failures from the timer ticking between extraction and save. Null means no daily grant (Grid 189 disabled or no matching passive source); no continuous accrual or offline replay is assumed.
